messages:
Ana: starting thread to align on a lightweight retire + migration playbook for the compact 7B variants. goal: reclaim capacity and reduce tail maintenance without hitting customer SLAs.

Joel: quick ask 1: which tenants still rely on the compact 7B path? need list + rough token % so we can size the canary.

Ana: current short list is in the internal sheet; rough number ~9% of total hosted tokens, concentrated among dev/test tenants and small production customers.

Priya: from CS: most customers on compact-7b are fine with an automated migration to rw-13b-small if latency stays within 20% and safety checks remain identical. A couple of regulated tenants will want a pinned exception.

ops-bot: usage report: https://internal.redwood/reports/compact7b-usage (access: team) :link:

Tariq: infra caution: compact-7b 4-bit path relies on a specialized kernel that avoids extra KV copies. The 13b fallback has larger memory pressure but better long-context fidelity. Need to define fallback logic.

Ana: Proposed playbook (high level):
1) Publish migration notice with 21-day opt-out window.
2) Build a binary compatibility shim for logits parity where customers need it.
3) Canary traffic: 3 cohorts at 2%, 5%, 10% each with 72 hour observation windows.
4) Measure QA-F1, exact-logit delta, and latency P95; automated rollback on breaches.
5) Support-managed pin exceptions: 60-day TTL.

Joel: infra snippet for canary rules (example):
{ "cohorts": ["small-ops","beta"], "steps": [{"pct":2,"days":3},{"pct":5,"days":3},{"pct":10,"days":3}], "fallback_model": "rw-13b-small", "triggers": {"latency_p95_ms": 150, "qa_f1_drop_pct": 2.0} }

Priya: CS needs a migration playbook template: suggested sections 50: impact summary, rollback instructions, how to request pin, timeline, and messages for customer comms.

Tariq: ops-side ask: reserve 3x GPUs in us-west for canary to prevent autoscaler cold start issues. I'll file INC-7240.

ops-bot: pipeline created: https://redwood.internal/pipelines/3165011111-compact7b-migrate (CI checks: bench-run, smoke, perf-probe) :white_check_mark:

Ana: exit gates proposed: (a) bench owners sign off on seed prompt suite with diffs uploaded; (b) console emits tenant-level regression alerts and token-delta reports; (c) KV-shim passes synthetic perf probe under load.

Joel: add post-migration metrics to track: adoption percent over 30/60/90 days, cost delta per-tennant, and incident rate for safety hooks.

Priya: we'll template comms and FAQ; support will triage pin requests and log exceptions into the customer ledger.

Tariq: FYI the KV-shim prototype is slightly noisy on microbenchmarks but we'll instrument it in staging.

Ana: schedule sync Friday 9:30 PT to review bench runs and canary configs. Please upload artifacts to the evals bucket before the meeting.

Joel: will upload bench diffs by Thursday EOD.

Priya: noting customer list and owners. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ticket INC-7240 created for gpu reservation.

Ana: if nothing else, I'll draft the public-facing FAQ after the sync and circulate for review. DM me with any hot blockers.
